newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SEOUL STOCKS SEEN RISING ON TECHNICAL REBOUND.
newsitem.headline: SEOUL STOCKS SEEN RISING ON TECHNICAL REBOUND.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to rise on Thursday on a technical rebound following two days of consolidation, brokers said.
"The market is highly likely to rise on a technical rebound," said Koh Kyong-bae of Hyundai Securities.

Brokers said much of the attention would be given to shares showing a big improvement or fall in first-half earnings. Most listed companies are due to release their first-half results between Thursday and Friday.
The composite stock index closed Wednesday down 0.19 points to 762.73.
Selected blue chip issues, which has supported the market from a steep fall on Wednesday, would continue to outperform the market on institutional and foreign buying, brokers said.
"Investors will particularly favour blue chips with strong first half performances," said Koh of Hyundai.

Brokers said banking shares could benefit from a news that the finance ministry was mulling ways to help Korea First Bank which has been hit by loan defaults by big conglomerates. The government steps included special loans from the central bank, rights issue offerings or lower provisions for non-performing loans. -- JEAN YOON (822) 727 5643
